rationale: Validate an opt-in persistent faster-disk working directory and staged/checksummed/fsynced canonical publication using real completed storage-diagnostic artifacts. Reserve2times measured input bytes conservatively for working data and metadata, no synthetic size/labels. Original retained; old/partial destinations never reused; no physicalcollector moved, noSQL, freshness/durability gates unmodified. Producer storageprobe naturally completed before validation. Single registered owner, new paths; no host-failure/concurrency safety claim.
